name: Programa de Pequeñas Donaciones del FMAM - Honduras
summary: Honduras' SGP country programme funds community-based organisations, especially women's, youth and Indigenous groups, for local biodiversity, land degradation and climate resilience projects.
reporting: Projects must include a monitoring component that tracks the indicators set by the programme under its 2024-2028 country strategy.
